lead.title: Anthropic opens research preview for its Model Hardware Standard
lead.summary: Anthropic's new standard lets AI agents safely discover and operate physical lab and manufacturing equipment, compressing a multi-week HHMI Janelia imaging experiment into a single day and lifting laser stabilization on QuEra quantum computers from 58% to 99.3%. The company plans to open-source it after further safety work.

top_stories.title: OpenAI, Anthropic and Big Tech issue joint call for AI-powered cyber defense
top_stories.summary: Sam Altman joined OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS, Google, Microsoft and Oracle in a joint call urging urgent global action on AI-powered cyber defense, warning the window to harden systems is limited.

top_stories.title: Google releases Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash video generation model
top_stories.summary: DeepMind's new model adds 40-second scene extension, first/last frame control and 3-second video references at up to 4K, and is live across the Gemini API, AI Studio, Cloud, Flow and the Gemini app — ranked #1 on the Text-to-Video Arena.

top_stories.title: OpenAI prepares $400M second venture fund
top_stories.summary: After a $175M debut backing Harvey, Cursor and others, OpenAI is readying a $400M fund for application-layer AI startups, per The Wall Street Journal.

items.title: SWE-Prime: fewer trajectories, better agent performance
items.summary: A two-stage SFT data selection method (trajectory screening, then segment-level loss weighting) beats full-data training using just the top 10% of trajectories, with relative gains up to 12.2% on SWE-Bench Pro and 24.2% on SWE-Bench Verified.

items.title: LeVJEPA: video pretraining without heuristic tricks
items.summary: The first video encoder trained under LeJEPA's collapse-free objective uses a single encoder plus projector and one hyperparameter, matching or beating V-JEPA 2 at matched epochs with 5.6-20.8x less compute and topping the strongest video baseline by 7.6 points on ImageNet-1K at matched FLOPs.

items.title: CLAP: video world models as zero-shot physical simulators
items.summary: Cross-embodiment world models trained on internet-scale heterogeneous video — reconciled via end-effector poses, language and latent actions — approach or beat single-embodiment SOTA on DROID, with code and models open-sourced.

items.title: Evolution strategies give LLMs broader reasoning coverage than GRPO
items.summary: A theoretical and empirical study shows ES yields broader reasoning coverage and better Pass@K than GRPO, whose entropy collapses in training, then proposes a sequential GRPO-ES hybrid that combines GRPO's Pass@1 strength with ES's Pass@K gains.

items.title: TTPO: label-free test-time policy optimization
items.summary: Distills matching rollouts while penalizing disagreeing ones via grouped RL, letting TTPO match label-supervised OPSD on five competition benchmarks without any labels and lifting Qwen3-1.7B from 38.0% to 45.2% in test-time training.

items.title: LMSYS and Nvidia share MiniMax-H3 optimization playbook for 8xH200
items.summary: Cache-DiT, step reuse, sparse attention and fused kernels deliver a ~1.95x lossless MiniMax-H3 speedup — and up to 6.24x with quality trade-offs — on 8xH200 GPUs.

items.title: Nous Research relaunches model catalog on its Portal
items.summary: portal.nousresearch.com now consolidates active free models, promos and a sortable list of all available models in one place.

items.title: Hermes Agent adds real-profile browsing
items.summary: The agent can now use a managed copy of an existing Chrome profile — logins and cookies included — to browse and act as the user.

items.title: SoftBank in talks to buy majority stake in 1X at ~$6B valuation
items.summary: The OpenAI-backed humanoid maker is in talks with SoftBank at roughly $6B — about 40% below 1X's earlier $10B target — which would give SoftBank control of the home-oriented NEO humanoid line.

items.title: US probes Apex Logistics over alleged Nvidia chip smuggling to China
items.summary: Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Security is examining 47 shipments from a Kuehne+Nagel freight unit that allegedly routed Super Micro servers with Nvidia chips to China via Southeast Asia and Hong Kong; Kuehne+Nagel stock fell up to 4.2%.

items.title: Hugging Face debuts Microduck, a $399 waddling open-ecosystem robot
items.summary: The second consumer robot from Hugging Face, after the Reachy Mini, targets developers and educators who want programmable physical AI on a budget.

items.title: Skydive — cloud agents that work across your tools
items.summary: Each agent gets its own cloud computer and codebase, reachable from Slack, email, iMessage, browser or terminal, with routines that keep running when your laptop is closed.

items.title: Experiential — open-source gateway that distills usage into a better model
items.summary: The Rust-native gateway manages self-hosted, frontier and open models with under 1 ms overhead and no token markup, optionally mining OTel traces to route each request to the optimal model or train a custom one.

items.title: New Qoder — agentic coding platform is now generally available
items.summary: Qoder's plan-execute-verify coding platform went GA on August 27, with 500 daily Qwen credits for individuals and 50% off Qwen models for enterprise until September 1.

items.title: Dreamtonics Instrument X — neural orchestral instruments without samples
items.summary: Neural acoustic modeling turns MIDI into editable modeled performances for strings, woodwinds and brass, running fully locally with no GPU required.

items.title: Understudy — scenario testing for AI agents
items.summary: An open-source tool for defining and running test scenarios to evaluate and harden agent behavior before shipping.
